# GCM Safety Nets - Hyderabad & Telangana

> Leading provider of professional safety nets, anti-bird netting, invisible grills, sports netting, and ceiling cloth drying hangers across Hyderabad and Secunderabad. ISO certified, 15+ years experience, 5-year warranty, same-day installation.

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Balcony Safety Nets**: High-grade Garware nylon and monofilament nets engineered to prevent accidental falls of children, pets, and objects. Breaking load capacity exceeding 120-150 kg.
- **Anti-Bird & Pigeon Netting**: UV-stabilized transparent & white pigeon nets (25mm to 30mm mesh). 100% humane, zero injury to birds, keeps balconies, ducts, and AC units clean from pigeon droppings.
- **Balcony Invisible Grills**: Marine-grade 316 stainless steel high-tensile wire rope (2mm - 3mm thickness, nylon-coated) with 400+ kg tensile load. Unobstructed panoramic city views with maximum fall security.
- **Box Cricket & Practice Nets**: Heavy-duty HDPE braided sports netting (1.5mm - 3.0mm thickness, 40mm mesh) with complete structural column framework, overhead cabling, and turf integration.
- **Ceiling Cloth Drying Hangers**: Space-saving pulley-operated 6-pipe and 4-pipe rust-proof stainless steel drying systems mounted to ceiling slabs.
- **Duct Area & Industrial Safety Nets**: Large-scale debris, fall-arrest, and duct-closure netting for high-rise residential societies, factories, and commercial complexes.
